capabilities: Sync the current note to a CSDN draft from the command palette or ribbon
Read title, description, tags, and cover from YAML frontmatter
Browse, search, paginate, and delete existing drafts in a draft manager panel
Open drafts in the CSDN editor for write-back editing
Manage multiple CSDN accounts with isolated browser profiles
disambiguation: Despite the name, it never publishes posts; automation only looks for the save draft button.
extras: Full usage documentation lives in an external Wiki; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Local image references are only detected and reported, not uploaded.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to save notes as CSDN blog drafts or manage those drafts without leaving the vault.

relations.evidence: syncs the current Markdown note to a CSDN blog draft
The bridge drives a Playwright Chromium browser to fill the CSDN Markdown editor

requires.name: CSDN account with one-time manual login per profile

summary: Syncs Markdown notes to CSDN blog drafts via a local Python/Playwright bridge, with a draft manager, multi-account support, and write-back editing.
